data.name: Forsythoside A
data.description: Phenylethanoid glycoside from Forsythiae Fructus that binds ASCL1 and blocks a downstream CCNB1/mTOR axis.
data.description_beginner: A compound from forsythia fruit, long used in traditional medicine. In lab work it sticks to the ASCL1 protein and shuts down a signalling chain that runs from there through CCNB1 to mTOR.
